title: Jacaranda Social Card Series Specification
description: Validated 9:16 knowledge-card series compiled from a verified or approved research package, for deterministic code rendering to 1080x1920 PNG (no image model, no PPTX). Exactly seven fixed-role cards. Every displayed number is a reference into the research package via an inline displayNumber — no literal numeric strings in hook/body. Version 0.1.0 (v2 draft). Fixed roles and rules are defined in docs and enforced additionally by packages/prompts/tests/validate.py check_card_series.

package_id.description: The research package this series was compiled from.

locale.description: Chinese-monolingual per the v2 decision; extend the enum when other locales are introduced.

as_of_date.description: Data cutoff shown on every card's source line.

style_version.description: Design-token/style set version; the renderer resolves all styling from tokens.

cards.description: Exactly seven cards; card_no 1..7 in canonical role order (see $defs/card role enum).

text.description: Chinese card copy resolved by the compiler. Literal numerals are rejected by the validator — numbers must be declared via inline_numbers.

display_transform.description: Render-time unit conversion; the underlying metric value is never edited.

show_sign_colour.description: Apply green/red signal colour by value sign.

sourceLine.description: Every card carries a non-empty source line (cutoff date + SRC ids); the counter_conclusion card carries the full source union.

claim_type.description: Dominant claim role shown as a 事实/推断/观点 chip.

inline_numbers.description: Every number rendered on the card is declared here; the validator rejects any literal numeral in hook/body not backed by one of these (or by a metric_ref at its own value).

caveat.description: Optional口径/风险 caveat; required on counter_conclusion.

audit_note.description: Audit-status marker; required on latest_disclosure (e.g. 已审计 / 未经审计).
